title: Azure incident affecting Australia Central, Australia Southeast, Canada East
impact: Between 20:30 UTC on 30 September 2026 and 02:15 UTC on 1 October 2026, customers using several Azure networking services – including Azure ExpressRoute Gateway, Azure Application Gateway, Azure Firewall, Azure Bastion, Azure Virtual WAN, and Azure VPN Gateway – experienced intermittent failures when performing service management operations.
